context: Model the harness on scripts/turso_acceptance.sh: opt-in, bounded, and never printing secrets. Read the hosted URL and provider configuration from the invoking environment, then explicitly unset TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN and TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN inside the harness so an inherited CI or shell credential cannot satisfy the run. Execute todo-db doctor --json under TODO_DB_AUTH_CONTRACT=v2 and assert exit 0 and a source field equal to TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND, then run one ordinary read command and assert success. Support two modes: default skips with a clear message and exit 0 when no hosted database or provider is configured, and --require turns that skip into a failure so the release gate cannot pass by silently skipping. Keep xtrace disabled around credential handling, assert that no output line contains the resolved token, and add a bash -n syntax step to .github/workflows/ci.yml next to the existing turso harness check while leaving the full run opt-in and local.
description: The v0.4.2 cycle passed 219 tests, Ruff, two CI matrices, scope checks, isolated wheel and sdist consumer smoke tests, and SHA-256 asset verification, and none of it executed the path a user takes. This repository's own tracker is .todo-db/standalone.sqlite, so it structurally cannot regress on hosted authentication locally, and CI injects credentials into the environment, which masks the exact failure being guarded against. Add scripts/hosted_auth_acceptance.sh: it removes every inherited TODO_DB_* credential variable, leaves only the configured provider, and asserts that doctor and one ordinary read succeed with provenance TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND. This is the gate that was missing, and it is the only check in the repository that can fail the way the user failed.

anti_patterns.dont: Assert only that the command exited 0
anti_patterns.instead: also assert the credential provenance is the provider
anti_patterns.why: an inherited environment token would otherwise produce a green run that proves nothing about the provider

anti_patterns.dont: Enable shell xtrace or echo the resolved credential while debugging the harness
anti_patterns.instead: keep tracing off around credential handling and assert absence of the token in output
anti_patterns.why: harness output lands in CI logs and tracker evidence

anti_patterns.dont: Let a missing hosted database or provider silently pass the check
anti_patterns.instead: skip loudly by default and fail under --require
anti_patterns.why: a silent skip reads as coverage and is how a gate becomes decorative

anti_patterns.dont: Run the acceptance check only in CI
anti_patterns.instead: make it locally runnable and required before an auth-touching release
anti_patterns.why: CI injects credentials into the environment, which is precisely the condition that hid the v0.4.2 failure

preserves.behavior: Inherited TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN and TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN are removed inside the harness, so an environment credential cannot make the run pass.
No token value, hosted URL, or provider output appears in harness output, CI logs, or tracker evidence.
The audit-monitor workflow keeps its read-only credential and is untouched by this item.
The full harness stays opt-in; CI gains only a syntax check and never receives a read-write credential.
The harness never reads or writes the repository's own .todo-db/standalone.sqlite tracker.

prior_art.concept: read-only workflow credential handling and provenance assertions
harness syntax validation as a cheap always-on CI step
opt-in bounded acceptance harness invoked outside the default test suite
non-secret doctor provenance fields used as assertions

verifications.command: rg -q 'unset' scripts/hosted_auth_acceptance.sh && rg -q 'TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN' scripts/hosted_auth_acceptance.sh && rg -q 'TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND' scripts/hosted_auth_acceptance.sh
verifications.description: The harness scrubs inherited credential variables and asserts provider provenance
The harness supports a fail-loud --require mode

verifications.command: if env -u TODO_DB_URL -u TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN -u TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN -u TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND bash scripts/hosted_auth_acceptance.sh --require; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi

set +e; env -u TODO_DB_URL -u TODO_DB_ACCEPTANCE_URL -u TODO_DB_AUTH_TOKEN -u TODO_DB_RO_AUTH_TOKEN -u TODO_DB_CREDENTIAL_COMMAND bash scripts/hosted_auth_acceptance.sh; status=$?; set -e; test "$status" -eq 77
verifications.description: Unconfigured invocation skips with exit 77 even under errexit
